old_row.text: ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದರ ಹೆಸರು ದೇಹಿ. ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ದೇಹಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಬಿಂದುಮಾತ್ರವೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ. ॥೨೫॥

new_row.text: ಅದೇ ದೇಹಿರೂಪವಾಗಿದೆ. (ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ: ‘ದೇಹಮೋಹಪ್ರವಾರಣಾತ್’ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣವಾಚಕ ಪದದ ನಿಖರ ಅರ್ಥ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ.) ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ದೇಹಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಬಿಂದುಮಾತ್ರವೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ. ॥೨೫॥

reviews.source_sanskrit: तदेव देहि रूपं च देहमोहप्रवारणात् । देहरूपं तथा तत्र बिंदुमात्रं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥२५॥

issues.detail: The printed देहमोहप्रवारणात् includes body and delusion; the current because it bears a body is not an adequate rendering and prematurely selects an operation. Do not guess removal versus covering or silently substitute another Sanskrit compound. Printed देहि रूपं is separated and has the short-i sign in देहि; its grammatical/orthographic interpretation is also retained as a hold. The candidate uses dehi-rūpa as a technical label, not a claim that the Sanskrit has been normalized. The second sentence is retained. Full unqualified replacement is null.

old_row.text: ಹೀಗೆ ತನ್ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳೂ ಪಂಚಭೂತಗಳೂ ಉಂಟಾದವು, ಸ್ವರಾಟನೇ. ಎಲ್ಲ ದೇಹವೂ ಪಂಚಭೂತಾತ್ಮಕವೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ॥೨೫॥

new_row.text: ತನ್ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳ ಮತ್ತು ಭೂತಗಳ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯು ಐದು ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ. ದೇಹವು ಪಂಚಭೂತಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆಯೂ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. (ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ: ‘ಸ್ವರಾಟ್’ ಪದದ ಅನ್ವಯ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ.) ॥೨೫॥

reviews.source_sanskrit: तन्मात्रा भूतसर्गश्च पंचपंचात्मकः स्वराट् । पंचभूतात्मको देहः सर्वत्रैव प्रदृश्यते ॥२५॥

issues.detail: Preserve the explicit five-plus-five count. प्रदृश्यते is is seen/appears, not merely is said. स्वराट् is clear in the original, but this context does not establish the current direct address ಸ್ವರಾಟನೇ to Pārvatī. A masculine nominative/predicative construal is possible; consonant-stem surface form alone is not sufficient to exclude every possible vocative analysis. Do not assign a guessed creator or predicate. The proposal leaves the word visible in a hold rather than silently dropping it. Full unqualified replacement is null.
